text:
rachel: Hey team — SummitCare asked for our RFI responses + POC scope. I uploaded the draft capmatrix and a POC plan. Need SE, Security, and Legal signoff before we send Wednesday AM. Attached: summitcare_rfi_v1.pdf, summitcare_capmatrix.csv

owen: Reviewing now. Two quick asks from buyer: 1) can we commit to 99.9% availability for the weeklong POC? 2) they want an embedding throughput estimate for 400 concurrent calls sustained for 2 hours/day.

tina: For availability, we can commit a best-effort SLA for the hosted trial; Dedicated reserved pool is required for contractual 99.9%. I'll add both options in the capmatrix.

sec-ops: Security checklist: draft missing KMS integration details, explicit retention for POC logs, and whether customer data will transit our accounts. Also request SOC2 link and ISO attestation. Fill Q19-Q25 in the security sheet.

rachel: Noted. Current proposal: customer-managed collector writes to their S3 in the customer's account; we never persist raw PII in our environment. I'll make that sentence explicit.

owen: POC plan suggestion: 2d setup/verify, 5d steady-state, 1d stress. Perf harness: 3-day ramp then two 2-hour peak windows. I'll attach `summit_benchmark_plan.md` and a small script. Snippet:
```
# run a quick embed smoke test
bash run_embed_harness.sh --model redwood-1b --concurrency 400 --duration 7200
```

sec-ops: If they need HSM-backed keys on-prem, our Private package can run with customer HSM but adds ~3 weeks to schedule. Call that out in POC constraints. Also confirm whether they need key rotation during the POC.

rachel: Good point — I'll add a KMS note and state rotation window (no rotation during the 1-week POC unless requested).

legal: I'll review liability and data terms. Two asks now: 1) include a DPA link in the RFI, 2) limit POC liability to direct damages with a carveout for gross negligence. Will upload redlines by EOD.

files-bot: Uploaded summitcare_rfi_v1.pdf (1.8MB), summitcare_capmatrix.csv (36KB), summit_benchmark_plan.md (2.8KB)

owen: Pricing nuance: embeddings billed per 1k units; with their expected traffic the conservative estimate is ~15% higher than our optimistic line. I'll add a `poc_pricing_breakdown.csv` showing optimistic/conservative/peak rows. Also note default quota bump time (48-72 hours).

tina: SE signoff: I validated the harness and added an example curl for infra teams:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/embed \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","input":"clinical note example"}'
```

sec-ops: Quick check complete. I'll update Q20 with the KMS/HSM phrasing and confirm the SOC2 link. One more: add a line clarifying we will not move customer data outside eu-central-1 for EU customers.

legal: Uploaded `summitcare_legal_redlines.docx` with DPA stub and tightened POC liability. If they request non-standard indemnities, escalate to me.

rachel: Thanks everyone. Final checklist: SE signoff (done), ProdSec signoff (sec-ops to confirm KMS lines), Legal redlines (done). I'll consolidate and send to SummitCare tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :rocket:
